pages.text: Coco had made some bread alone, starting with the dough. Three little round loaves.
Today they would go on the display shelf for the first time. Who would buy them? Coco's heart went thump, thump.
The regular customers heard and hurried over. "I'll buy Coco's first bread!"
"I'm the first customer!" said Grandpa. "I got here first!" said Mrs. Magpie.
"My share should be the biggest!" said Mr. Pig. All three argued in front of the shelf.
Three loaves, three customers. Yet nobody bought anything. They just argued.
Then Mom, still in her apron, stood right in front of the shelf. She set down a coin.
"I'm the first customer." Mom chose one of Coco's loaves.
She took a bite right there, slowly, with her eyes closed. "The tastiest bread in our shop."
The other two sold in the blink of an eye. Coco's spot on the shelf was bright and empty.
